name: Bengaluru E-Waste Planner demonstration data
source: Generated deterministically by this project; no official spatial source
assumptions: All shapes, locations and attributes are artificial and are not official Bengaluru boundaries, roads, facilities, population or environmental constraints.
Any synthetic demand values are illustrative planning inputs, not observed or official waste generation.
SYN-C02 carries a synthetic hard_allowed=false flag to demonstrate configurable exclusion behavior.
No regulatory buffer distance is encoded as a fact; any demonstration exclusion distance must be exposed as an editable assumption.
generation_method: fixed deterministic coordinates and attributes; seed recorded for fixture versioning; no random sampling
